title: [C#] Failed to add a custom resource loader error when performing rebuild
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.stable.mono.official [4c311cbee]

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7270) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900HS with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

When writing a custom resource format loader `MyFmtLdr` that inherits `ResourceFormatLoader`, every project rebuild will cause the Godot Editor to print 
```
ERROR: Failed to add a custom resource loader, script 'res://MyFmtLdr.cs' does not inherit 'ResourceFormatLoader'.
```

`MyFmtLdr.cs`
```csharp
[GlobalClass]
public partial class MyFmtLdr : ResourceFormatLoader
{
    private static readonly string[] _extensions = ["myfmt"];
    public override string[] _GetRecognizedExtensions() => _extensions;
    public override bool _HandlesType(StringName type) => true;
    public override string _GetResourceType(string path) => nameof(MyFormatResource);
    public override Variant _Load(string path, string originalPath, bool useSubThreads, int cacheMode) =>
        new MyFormatResource { Data = FileAccess.GetFileAsString(path) };
}
```

`MyFormatResource.cs`
```csharp
[GlobalClass]
public partial class MyFormatResource : Resource
{
    [Export] public string Data { get; set; }

    public override void _ValidateProperty(Dictionary property)
    {
        if (property.TryGetValue("name", out var value)
            && value.AsStringName() == PropertyName.Data
            && property.ContainsKey("usage"))
            property["usage"] = Variant.From(PropertyUsageFlags.Default | PropertyUsageFlags.ScriptVariable | PropertyUsageFlags.ReadOnly);
    }
}
```

`example.myfmt`
```
Lorem Ipsum is simply dummy text of the printing and typesetting industry.
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Download the [mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19217065/mrp_resfmtldr_2025-03-13_03-54-15.zip)
2. Open with Godot Editor 4.4 with mono module
3. Build the C# project
4. Restart the editor so the built `MyFmtLdr` gets loaded
5. Rebuild the C# project
6. Observe the issue

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1913c47a-36c6-4a37-8f9c-9409a0b6b30e
